# m.stocks.filings.institutional_holdings

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Holdings that institutional managers report on Form 13-F, one row per position.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.stocks.filings.institutional_holdings(*, filer_cik=None, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None, on_error=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.APPEND`, which appends each row it hasn't seen, identified by `AccessionNumber`, `Cusip`, `TitleOfClass`, `PutCall`, `InvestmentDiscretion`, `OtherManagers`, `SharesOrPrincipalAmount`, `SharesOrPrincipalType`, `VotingAuthoritySole`, `VotingAuthorityShared` and `VotingAuthorityNone`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `filer_cik` | The manager's SEC CIK, as text with its leading zeros, such as `"0001067983"`, or a sequence of them; leave it out for every manager. |
| [`start`](README.md#start) | The first filing date. |
| [`end`](README.md#end) | The last filing date. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Any of Massive's field names, such as `"market_value"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters. Keys: none. |
| [`on_error`](README.md#on_error) | What a bad symbol or row does in this call (`dm.ErrorPolicy`). None, the default, takes each cause from the session's `MassiveConfig.on_error`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Institutional Holdings (13-F) (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Updated daily |
| Stocks Starter | Updated daily |
| Stocks Developer | Updated daily |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated daily |
| Stocks Business | Updated daily |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AccessionNumber` | String | Unique SEC accession number for the filing (e.g., '0000950123-24-011775'). |
| `Cusip` | String | The CUSIP identifier for the held security. |
| `FileNumber` | String | The 13F-specific file number assigned to the filer. |
| `FilerCik` | String | SEC Central Index Key (10 digits, zero-padded) of the filing entity. |
| `FilingDate` | String | Date when the filing was submitted to the SEC (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `FilingUrl` | String | Direct URL to the filing on the SEC EDGAR website. |
| `FilmNumber` | String | SEC EDGAR film number for the filing. |
| `FormType` | String | SEC form type (e.g., '13F-HR' for holdings report, '13F-HR/A' for amended report). |
| `InvestmentDiscretion` | String | Type of investment discretion. Possible values: SOLE, SHARED, DFND (defined). |
| `IssuerName` | String | Name of the company whose securities are held. |
| `MarketValue` | long | Market value of the holding in USD. |
| `OtherManagers` | String[] | List of names of other manager(s) sharing investment discretion over the reported holdings, if applicable. |
| `Period` | String | The quarter end date that the filing covers (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `PutCall` | String | Indicates if the holding is a put or call option. Possible values: PUT, CALL, or empty for common stock. |
| `SharesOrPrincipalAmount` | long | Number of shares or principal amount held. |
| `SharesOrPrincipalType` | String | Type of amount reported. Possible values: SH (shares), PRN (principal amount). |
| `TitleOfClass` | String | Description of the class of securities held (e.g., 'COM', 'CL A'). |
| `VotingAuthorityNone` | long | Number of shares with no voting authority. |
| `VotingAuthorityShared` | long | Number of shares with shared voting authority. |
| `VotingAuthoritySole` | long | Number of shares with sole voting authority. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
